name: Next.js 16
description: Integrated fullstack with Next.js 16, React Compiler, Turbopack, and instant startup
long_description: Production-ready Next.js 16.1 starter with App Router, React 19.2, the stable React Compiler, Turbopack, API routes, TypeScript 5.9, and Tailwind CSS v4.2. Includes View Transitions, Cache Components, and Server Actions. Pre-baked dependencies for instant startup.

name: Vite + React + FastAPI
description: Separated fullstack with Vite React frontend and FastAPI Python backend
long_description: Full-stack template with explicit separation: Vite + React for the frontend and FastAPI for the backend. Includes CORS setup, hot reload for both servers, PostgreSQL integration, and example CRUD API endpoints. Perfect for data science and ML applications.

name: Vite + React + Go
description: High-performance fullstack with Vite React frontend and Go backend
long_description: Performance-focused fullstack template with Vite + React for the frontend and Go with Chi router for the backend. Includes Air for hot reloading, CORS middleware, example REST endpoints, and WebSocket support. Ideal for real-time applications and microservices.

name: Expo
description: Cross-platform mobile app with Expo Router and React Native
long_description: Modern Expo starter template with file-based routing, React Native 0.83, React 19.2, and multi-platform support. Perfect for building iOS, Android, and web applications from a single codebase with hot reload and TypeScript. Features Expo Router for intuitive navigation and Metro bundler for optimized performance.

name: Pi Web Starter
description: A minimal self-hosted web application starter with the official Pi JavaScript SDK loaded from the documented Pi CDN and initialized for Pi Browser/sandbox development. Authentication and payments are intentionally excluded.
long_description: Pi-compatible Vite + React + FastAPI shell that loads https://sdk.minepi.com/pi-sdk.js and calls Pi.init({ version: "2.0", sandbox }). Includes Developer Portal setup docs and clear boundaries: no Pi.authenticate, no /v2/me, no payments, no Server API Key, no App Studio automation. Primary skill: pi-sdk. Related: pi-developer-portal, pi-browser. Auth and payments deferred to later starters/skills.

name: Pi Auth Starter
description: Pi-compatible web starter with official SDK init plus generated-app Pi authentication (Pi.authenticate + backend GET /v2/me). Not OpenSail login. Payments intentionally excluded.
long_description: Extends Pi Web Starter with Pi.authenticate(["username"], …) and generated-app backend verification against https://api.minepi.com/v2/me using Bearer user tokens. Establishes app-local verified-user state only — never wires into OpenSail OAuth/JWT. Zero Server API Key and zero payment routes. Primary skills: pi-auth, pi-sdk, pi-platform-api, pi-browser.
